sans.$value: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

mono.$value: ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Code', 'Source Code Pro', Menlo, Consolas, monospace

tight.$description: Tightening for large sizes (display, the top headings)

wide.$description: Letter spacing for all-caps micro labels (overline)

in-out.$description: Symmetric: both the start and the end are eased. Looping animations that cross the track (an indeterminate VProgressLinear).

surface-skeleton.$description: The background of the loading silhouettes (VSkeletonLoader); the highlight derives from it in CSS

text-on-inverse.$description: Text set on an inverted surface

text-on-accent.$description: Text set on an accent/danger/success background

text-on-warning.$description: Text set on a solid warning background (amber too light for white)

accent-text.$description: Accent text on a neutral or tinted background

family.$description: The font of all the design system text

family-heading.$description: The font of the display and heading roles; identical to the running font until it is overridden

family-code.$description: The font of code content (the code variant, VInputOTP)

fast.$description: Colour and border changes on hover, focus, press

base.$description: The default: a panel opening, a value moving

slow.$description: Movements large enough to be followed by the eye

border-width.$description: The border of checkable controls (VCheckbox, VRadio)

size-check.$description: The box of checkable controls (VCheckbox, VRadio)

action-size-xs.$description: The most compact inner buttons (removing VCombobox's tags)

action-size-sm.$description: The inner buttons of sm input fields (clear, a clickable icon)

action-size-md.$description: The inner buttons of md input fields (clear, a clickable icon)

action-size-lg.$description: The inner buttons of lg input fields (clear, a clickable icon)

size-slider-length.$description: The default length of a vertical VSlider

size-slider-field.$description: The width of VSlider's number fields

size-carousel-block.$description: The default block size of VCarousel's viewport. Load-bearing in the vertical orientation: a percentage flex-basis has no definite reference on the block axis, and every slide would collapse onto its content without it

size-carousel-indicator.$description: The diameter of a VCarousel indicator dot (its hit area comes from --vectis-control-height-xs)

size-carousel-indicator-active.$description: The main-axis size of the ACTIVE VCarousel indicator, which stretches from a dot into a pill

size-combobox-input-min.$description: The minimum width of VCombobox's input area

size-combobox-list-max-block.$description: The maximum height of VCombobox's list panel (the scrolling area)

size-menu-min.$description: The minimum width of VMenu's panel

size-menu-max.$description: The maximum width of VMenu's panel

size-progress-linear-thickness.$description: The default thickness of VProgressLinear's bar (4px)

size-progress-linear-length.$description: The default length of a vertical VProgressLinear (overridable through `height`)

size-progress-circular-thickness.$description: The default stroke thickness of VProgressCircular (4px)

size-skeleton-surface.$description: The default height of a surface-shaped VSkeletonLoader — a card, an image (96px)

size-toast-width.$description: The default width of a toast

size-badge-dot.$description: The diameter of VBadge in dot mode

size-avatar-ring.$description: The separating ring of stacked Avatars (VAvatarGroup)

size-calendar-cell.$description: The side (height/width) of a VCalendar day cell

size-calendar-dot.$description: The diameter of a VCalendar event dot

size-calendar-nav-min.$description: The minimum width of VCalendar's month/year picker buttons (≈86px)

size-tab-indicator.$description: The thickness of the active tab indicator (VTabs, flat/outlined)

size-table-search.$description: The width of VDataTable's search field

size-timepicker-dial.$description: The diameter of VTimePicker's dial (the M3 spec)

size-timepicker-number.$description: A numeral cell on VTimePicker's dial, and the hand's dot on a marker

size-timepicker-center.$description: The centre dot of VTimePicker's dial

size-timepicker-hand.$description: The thickness of the hand on VTimePicker's dial

size-timepicker-hand-minor.$description: The dot of VTimePicker's hand on a minute off the 5-minute markers

size-timepicker-cell-w.$description: The width of an hour/minute picker in VTimePicker's panel (the height comes from the control scale)

size-timepicker-list-max-block.$description: The maximum height of VTimePicker's list panel (the scrolling area)

size-upload-min-block.$description: The minimum height of VFileUpload's drop zone — icon, two lines, separator and button

size-upload-icon.$description: The large icon at the top of VFileUpload's drop zone

size-upload-thumb.$description: The thumbnail square of a VFileUpload preview row (an image, or its type icon)
